roleInfo.admin: Everything: users, teams, platforms and credentials, settings, all processes
roleInfo.designer: Create processes; edit and run processes (unless restricted)
roleInfo.auditor: Read-only access to all processes, runs, protocols and the audit log
roleInfo.viewer: Read-only access to processes and their runs (unless restricted)
roleInfo.status: Only the service status pages – none of the other pages, processes, platforms or data
roleInfo.plant: Sees only the plant registry (sites and assets, unless a site is restricted) – none of the other pages, processes, services or documents

saveBar.label: Save changes
saveBar.invalid: Unsaved changes – correct the marked fields to save them

formModal.discardMessage: What you entered in this dialog is not saved.

validation.url: Enter a web address that starts with http:// or https://
validation.currency: A three-letter currency code, e.g. EUR
validation.currencyWhole: A whole amount: {{currency}} has no decimals

tags.hint: A key, optionally with a value: type the key, Tab to the value, Enter to add (e.g. env: prod, or just pci).

problem.key: A key with a value uses letters, digits, . _ - and / only.
problem.long: The key or the value is too long.

whoCanAct.runs: Operators, designers and administrators start runs of the processes they may run.
whoCanAct.schedules: Whoever may run a process schedules it: operators, designers and administrators.
whoCanAct.triggers: Whoever may run a process adds a webhook trigger for it: operators, designers and administrators.
whoCanAct.credentials: Operators, designers and administrators document credential entries.
whoCanAct.records: Operators, designers and administrators write documents.
whoCanAct.tickets: Operators, designers and administrators add ticket references.
whoCanAct.personReviews: Designers and administrators start person reviews.
whoCanAct.evidencePacks: Everyone except viewers exports evidence packs.
whoCanAct.users: Administrators invite users and create teams.
whoCanAct.plantAssets: Whoever manages a site adds its assets: designers and administrators, or the people its access list names.

duplicate.title: Duplicate
duplicate.intro: Creates a copy of “{{name}}” that belongs to you.
duplicate.name: Name of the copy
duplicate.keyHint: Lower-case letters, digits and - (must be free)
duplicate.noPlatforms: Platform mappings are not copied: a platform belongs to one application.
duplicate.copyAccess: Copy the access settings (access list and owning teams)
duplicate.copyOwners: Copy the owners and owning teams
duplicate.copyAccessHint: Everyone who has access to the original gets the same access to the copy.
duplicate.accessNotCopied: The access settings are not copied: only who may manage the original can copy them. The copy gets your default teams.
duplicate.rules: Secrets, history, runs and results are not copied; the copy gets new secrets where it needs them.

duplicate.copiedFromHidden: A copy, made on {{date}} by {{by}} (the original is gone or not visible to you).
duplicate.plantScope: The copy belongs to the same owning teams as the original (and is Restricted if the original is); who the original is shared with is not copied.
duplicate.systemNote: The copy has the attributes and the stack entered by hand, and is in the same segments without the original’s addresses. The CMDB entry, the platform and the systems in a segment are not copied.
